title: Pipeline Fixture: Every Scene Type (Test Data)
summary: Automated test episode for the video pipeline. Every number here is invented test data about a fictional company.

scenes.narration: This is a test of the whole video pipeline. Every number you see is invented. Nothing here is real news.

The bar chart compares values side by side, and the last bar is highlighted.
